UC-1297.en: Not sent: you sent a newer message first. It's back in the box below.
UC-1297.note: The composer's working line when a message never started because the lawyer sent a newer one now first (#1314: unsent sent_now). The words are back in the box.

UC-1298.en: Not sent: the answer it was for had stopped. It's back in the box below.
UC-1298.note: The composer's working line when a held steer never started because the answer it was for had stopped (#1314: unsent not_sent). The words are back in the box.

UC-1299.en: An update was running. This message waits in the queue and goes once the update is done.
UC-1299.note: The queue's line under its head while a queued message is the host's copy of one held for an update (#1314: copy_of.cause update on the copy, the original's entry may be missing). The update may be Clauseo's own or the agent's (its download), so the words name neither. The original's words don't come back to the box: the copy is the message. The installing line (queue_held_reason update) takes its place while Clauseo's update installs.

UC-1247.en: You were signed out of {agent}. This message waits in the queue and goes once you're signed in.
UC-1247.note: The queue's line while a queued message is the host's copy of one held for the agent's sign-in (#1314: copy_of.cause sign_in); {agent} is Claude or ChatGPT. The original's words don't come back to the box. Same shape as UC-1299.
